<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **11** documentable anchor(s).

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via NavigationConfigSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **5** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **174** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4609c48962b94289fe0ceeb7dd0076e2b02b0790` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `8985dd583e4a463f97f1592aa51cbde2155325c0` — the merge of head `56c006efaef8592ceb61313f15901563d6f395a8` into base `4609c48962b94289fe0ceeb7dd0076e2b02b0790`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 8985dd583e4a463f97f1592aa51cbde2155325c0 && git checkout 8985dd583e4a463f97f1592aa51cbde2155325c0
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 4609c48962b94289fe0ceeb7dd0076e2b02b0790 56c006efaef8592ceb61313f15901563d6f395a8 && git checkout -B drift-repro 4609c48962b94289fe0ceeb7dd0076e2b02b0790 && git merge --no-ff 56c006efaef8592ceb61313f15901563d6f395a8

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 4609c48962b94289fe0ceeb7dd0076e2b02b0790
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 4609c48962b94289fe0ceeb7dd0076e2b02b0790` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 维护者速读
- 按您的规则改了从列表打开记录的方式：点记录名称直接进整页；鼠标移到某一行时，名称旁出现「在侧边打开」小图标，点它才在右侧打开，列表还在。手机上点名称进整页。
- 「选项」里的「打开记录：抽屉 / 整页」设置去掉了，以前存的个人偏好不再起作用；抽屉里「撑满」的状态也去掉了，只留一个放大按钮，点了进整页。
- 抽屉改成四周留边、圆角带阴影的悬浮卡片。从列表进整页时会记住来自哪个列表（视图、筛选、排序、条数），刷新不丢，返回时回到原来的位置；地址栏里不多任何东西。
- 视图上的「打开方式」设置标记为废弃：旧的写法照常加载不报错，但不再起作用；写了「不打开」的列表仍然不打开。
- 席位意见：通过。改动超过 3000 行且涉及对外规范，需要席位做接口复核再交人工合并；合并前在更新说明里补两点（见下）。

## 席位核对
**ACCEPT** · head `c35de251b9` · Fixes #35854 (epic #35590; maintainer named the card 14:23Z; deprecation ruling 「废弃」, card comment 7039654214) · K=6 · merge-tree vs `origin/main` clean · governed: no · +1091/−1917, 80 files (**3008 > 3000**) · CI 65 success, 13 skipped, 0 pending · 2026-11-20T19:26Z

**reviewFace** (committed file list + PR body declarations): face **`schema`**, tier **`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`**, `hits.schema` = `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.navigation-mode-record-open-deprecated.ts`, `packages/spec/src/ui/view.form.ts`, `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`; `hits.rules = []`. Routing: **L2 by the seat at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER, then Tier H (over 3000 lines): a human merge by GOVERNED_APPROVERS.**

Checked:
- Row click (`handleRowClick`): no record surface → nothing; `navOverlay.mode === 'none'` → nothing, a modifier click included (#33548 kept); ⌘/Ctrl/middle → the hook's new-tab path; otherwise `navigateTo(id)`, the full page with this list as origin. The handler stays stable (`rowClickInputs` ref), so the list does not re-render on `?recordId=`.
- Mode derivation: phone → the derived mobile surface; authored `none` or `preventNavigation: true` → `none`; everything else → `drawer` with the authored `width` / `size`. So `drawer` / `page` / `new_window` change nothing, as the semantic entry says.
- Side panel: `openInPanel` exists only for `mode === 'drawer'` on a non-phone viewport and rides the existing `recordLinkAdornment` channel (the slot that carried the old "open as page" arrow), so it sits inside the name cell with no fixed column. It pushes `?recordId=`, keeping the drawer shareable and refresh-safe.
- Drawer ⤢: root → close + `handleNavOverlayNavigate` (list origin kept); a deeper level → `expandedRecordPath` with the levels below as `?from=`. Maximize-in-place and its width math are gone; 「收为抽屉」 is gone with it.
- Provenance in `location.state.from` (point 2): survives reload, nothing new in the URL; `total` is added only when the sibling set is unscoped and `total ≥` the rows shown.
- Spec (for the L2, point 1): the key stays and `default('drawer')` stays, so every value parses; `@deprecated` + `[DEPRECATED]` describe and form help text; a D3 semantic entry with no conversion, which is right because stripping `none` would change behaviour. The retired-member FIX sentence is updated in the same file, and its pin test follows.
- Removed tests (point 4) pin only the removed preference, the Display menu section and maximize-in-place; their replacements are `recordOpenPath-35854` (unit) and `record-open-path-35854` (live e2e).
- Surface: claim 7042020341 + amendments 2–7, per ux-4; no plugin-grid change, since the adornment channel already existed.

Required before landing:
- **R1 (`openNewTab`, text or code; the L2 picks).** `navigation.openNewTab: true` ("Force open in new tab (applies to page mode)") used to make the object list open the page in a new tab. A plain name click now runs `navigateTo(id)` and ignores it. Either honour it on the name click, or say in the changeset and the semantic entry that it no longer applies to the object list. No first-party metadata sets it.
- **R2 (changeset migration lines).** `@object-ui/components` drops `NavigationOverlay`'s `maximizable` prop and the `SIDEBAR_WIDTH_FALLBACK` / `SIDEBAR_WIDTH_ICON_FALLBACK` exports. AGENTS.md §changesets: a removed export carries FROM → TO and a one-line fix ("delete `maximizable`; the drawer's ⤢ opens the full page", "inline `'16rem'` / `'3rem'`"). Add the ADR-0087 marker too if `check:adr-0087-registration` counts it as breaking.

Nits (no action required):
- Point 3: `ConsoleToaster` keys its inset detection on ≤ 16px from the edge; a future card wider inset would need that number moved with it.
- Point 5: the stale ADR-0050 note is in #35870; nothing here edits `docs/adr`.

## 席位核对
**delta ACCEPT** (on ACCEPT 7048643367) · head `56c006efae` (two commits on `c35de251b9`) · K=10 · merge-tree vs `origin/main` clean · delta +28/−8, 3 files (PR now 3030 lines) · CI 62 success, 11 skipped; the cancelled `PR-body guards` run (19:35:50Z) is superseded by a success (19:36:33Z) · 2026-11-20T20:08Z

Routing unchanged: **L2 by the seat at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER** (face `schema`, same three `hits.schema` paths), then **Tier H**.

- R1 (the L2 chose to honour it), `56c006efae`: the derived drawer config now carries `openNewTab: authored?.openNewTab`, and `handleRowClick` sends a plain click down the hook's new-tab path when it is set, the same branch a ⌘/Ctrl/middle click takes. `none` and `preventNavigation` still return first, so they outrank it, and the side-panel icon (`handleOpenRowInPanel`, a URL param) is unaffected. On a phone the derived mobile surface is returned before this, so the flag does not apply there, which is unchanged from main. Pinned in `ObjectView.recordOpenPath-35854`, ablation 1/9 red. The changeset says the key stays live. Closed.
- R2, `6ad5b33a8a`: FROM → TO lines with a one-line fix each for `maximizable` and both `SIDEBAR_WIDTH_*` exports. `check:adr-0087-registration` reports no declared-breaking changeset, so no marker is owed. Closed.

No required item at L1.
